requirements: Settings MUST read from the process environment and a local .env file; krx_openapi_key has no default so a missing key raises pydantic ValidationError (fail-closed).
All API credentials MUST be typed SecretStr. repr(Settings) and str(Settings) MUST NOT contain the raw secret value.
get_settings MUST be memoised (functools.lru_cache) so that two calls return the identical object.
TradingCalendar MUST delegate every session decision to exchange_calendars XKRX. No hardcoded holiday list, no weekday arithmetic, no pandas.bdate_range.
get_calendar MUST be memoised per calendar name; constructing the XKRX calendar costs ~1s and MUST NOT happen per call.
sessions/session_count MUST be inclusive on both endpoints and MUST raise ValueError when start > end.
previous_session/next_session MUST raise ValueError when the requested offset falls outside the loaded calendar range; silent clamping is forbidden.
previous_session/next_session MUST accept a non-session input date and resolve relative to the surrounding sessions.

DataPaths.bronze MUST map endpoint 'etp/etf_bydd_trd' and bas_dd 2026-08-27 to root/'raw/krx/etp/etf_bydd_trd/2026/20260827.json'; silver(table) to root/'normalized/<table>.parquet'; gold(table) to root/'features/<table>.parquet'; state(name) to root/'state/<name>.json'.
DataPaths methods MUST resolve the result and raise ValueError when the resolved path escapes DataPaths.root (guards '..' and absolute-path injection).
DataPaths MUST NOT create directories as a side effect of path computation.
configure_logging MUST attach exactly one console handler at the requested level and one file handler at DEBUG writing to log_root/'sys.log'; repeated calls MUST NOT duplicate handlers.
Structured debug records MUST use the '[TAG] key=value key=value' form with TAG restricted to LOG_TAGS; floats formatted to at most 3 decimals.
Production modules MUST NOT call print(); all output goes through logging.
cli.main MUST return 0 on success and a non-zero int on unknown subcommand or handler failure, and MUST NOT raise SystemExit for handled errors.
cmd_config_check MUST validate Settings and DataPaths and report which credentials are present as booleans only, never their values.
cmd_calendar MUST use TradingCalendar to report the session count for the requested range.
SUBCOMMANDS MUST be a module-level mutable registry mapping subcommand name to handler so later stages can register without editing main().

scenarios.expected_behavior: previous_session(date(2026,8,18)) == date(2026,8,14); next_session(previous_session(d)) == d for every d in sessions(date(2026,1,5), date(2026,8,27)); session_count(a,b) with a > b raises ValueError.

With KRX_OPENAPI_KEY absent from the environment, Settings() raises pydantic.ValidationError. With it set to 'SECRET123', repr(settings) and str(settings) contain neither 'SECRET123' nor the substring 'SECRET', while settings.krx_openapi_key.get_secret_value() == 'SECRET123'.

DataPaths(root).bronze('etp/etf_bydd_trd', date(2026,8,27)) == root/'raw/krx/etp/etf_bydd_trd/2026/20260827.json'; silver('etf_daily') == root/'normalized/etf_daily.parquet'; gold('features_etf') == root/'features/features_etf.parquet'; state('krx_quota') == root/'state/krx_quota.json'; bronze('../../etc', date(2026,8,27)) and silver('/abs') each raise ValueError; no directory is created by any of these calls.

After two consecutive configure_logging(log_root=tmp) calls the root logger holds exactly 2 handlers; a debug record '[SYS] stage=probe elapsed_ms=12' is written to tmp/'sys.log' and matches the regex '^\\[(SYS|DATA|ALGO|EVAL)\\]( \\w+=\\S+)+$' after the formatter prefix is stripped.

main(['calendar', '--start', '2026-09-21', '--end', '2026-11-13']) returns 0 and logs session_count=36; main(['no-such-command']) returns a non-zero int without raising; 'config-check' and 'calendar' are both keys of SUBCOMMANDS.
With KRX_OPENAPI_KEY='SECRET123' in the environment, main(['config-check']) returns 0 and the captured log output contains 'krx_openapi_key=True' and does not contain 'SECRET123'.
